title: cup warmer
text: cup warmer. This is a very simple cup warmer.  It has a cord to plug in.  A fairly good sized warming circle area - approx 3" - eye balling it which means it will fit most cups - although flat bottom mugs are the best for coverage and benefit.  It has a toggle push button on/off.  It does NOT auto off - which is kinda ok for me because I usually have one cup and then turn it off.  If you tend to leave your cup... probably not a good choice for you.  It does warm... but not really heat.  Meaning - it keeps hot beverages kind of warm - but not hot.  It's barely warm enough for me - but much better than room temp.  So, it's personal choice/opinion.  The stand has four little molded legs with rubber non skids on them.  The actual warming plate is quite warm... so if you put something plastic on it... or other... melting and damage would occur - obviously, right?  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  I and I hope this info was helpful for you.
